sprint: Image Studio Redesign Ship B — refinements pass on top of the base Ship B brush/crop port. Four concrete, screenshot-driven UX corrections landing together in js/pictureStudio.js: (1) Always-visible kid zoom slider (🔍 range input 🔎) above the stage, replacing the old Bigger/Smaller tile+sub-panel entirely (matches tools/background-remover/'s own established .kid-zoom-row pattern). (2) Restructured primary-tile grid to exactly Remove More / Bring It Back / Trim Picture / Turn / Flip per the reference screenshot, plus the brush cursor is now a real CIRCLE (a position:absolute DIV overlay following the mouse in brush mode, sized to brush radius × current zoom, pointer-events:none, border-radius:50%, kid-friendly gold ring) instead of the browser's default hand pointer — wired via a new window.addEventListener('mousemove',...) branch that always positions _brushCursor.style.left/top relative to the stage's own bounding rect whenever brush mode is active, separate from and additive to the pre-existing _brushPainting/_cropDrag/_drag gesture branches. (3) Remove Bigger/Smaller as a tile (→ always-visible slider) and remove Remove Background as a tile (→ auto-run with animation on image load) — only Brighten + Peek Original remain as extras on top of the background-remover's own baseline sub-panel. (4) The '✨ Making the paper disappear...' initial animation is finally shown — a new .picture-studio-magic-overlay DOM element (a sparkle emoji + friendly message on a semi-transparent backdrop with a pulse keyframe) is inserted into the stage, revealed by _startBgRemoval before the worker call, hidden by _onBgResult/_onBgError, and defensively hidden by _hide() (cancel/close mid-removal). Bg removal now auto-runs immediately after every _origImg load path (HTMLImageElement, string→loadImg, File→FileReader), matching the tools/background-remover/ auto-run convention exactly. CSS additions in css/style.css: new .picture-studio-kid-zoom-row/-glyph/-slider, .picture-studio-brush-cursor (+.hidden), .picture-studio-magic-overlay/-sparkle/-message (+.hidden), the picture-studio-magic-pulse keyframe; sub-panel dispatch selector updated to match Ship B's rename (data-active-tool='bg' → 'brush', added 'crop'). Cache-bust bumped ?v=0311→?v=0312 across every script/link tag in root index.html.
